CustomField.description: True when a Benefiting Group line says nothing about who is covered, so the Order Form would print a bare "Benefiting Group". Mirrors every source License_Model_Display__c prints from: Description, Function Name, Benefitting Group (single), Benefitting Group (multi-select functions - the column the quote line editor shows on multi-year rows) and Group Type. Both send flows block on this (18 Sep 2026: the old check ignored the multi-select and Group Type). 21 Sep 2026: Group Type is read through Order_Form_BG_Type_Words__c, which also covers the Law.com BG Group field.
CustomField.formula: AND( TEXT(License_Model__c) = "Benefiting Group", ISBLANK(Benefiting_Group_Description__c), ISBLANK(Function_Name__c), ISBLANK(Order_Form_BG_Type_Words__c), ISBLANK(Order_Form_BG_Functions__c) )
CustomField.label: Order Form: group not described
